lessons.claim: Failing after warmup is not a complete target census; preserve original receipts and attempt identity.
Capture budget likely insufficient; v1 lacks exact exception category.
Sampled child RSS is not measured whole-job peak and cannot be submitted as strict RunObservation.peak_rss_bytes.
Current runner has no private state restore; restart repeats formation, not an independent scientific sample.
Closed half-tick intersections can lack an observable integer print; geometric coincidence is not an arrival.
More zones create more exposure; test incremental information against opportunity and occupancy controls.
Racimos derive from AVZ and are not independent confirming votes.
Synthetic exact equivalence and asymptotic improvements are not measured market speedups.

optimization_candidates.change: Typed private storage and separated serialization/index timing, preserving ordered capture hashes and all records.
Share identical TapeWindow primitives across configs only after proving exact session/residual availability.
Persist private state inside Kaggle with full code/input/params/history binding; no checkpoint raw export and no automatic resume.
Calculate features only at actual anchors; process first passage using shared heaps.
Exact band selection with preserved original tie order; full membership snapshots still cost linear work.
